## Software Recommendations

This page provides comprehensive guidance on recommended software tools, packages, and libraries for analytics and data science work. Our recommendations are based on team experience, industry standards, and ongoing evaluation of emerging technologies.

Stay up-to-date with our approved software stack to ensure compatibility and optimal performance across projects.

## Approved Software Catalog

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

# Create sample software catalog data
software_data <- data.frame(
  Software_Name = c("R", "Python", "RStudio", "VS Code", "Jupyter",
                    "Git", "Docker", "PostgreSQL", "Tableau", "Power BI",
                    "Quarto", "Posit Connect", "Shiny", "Plotly", "ggplot2",
                    "pandas", "scikit-learn", "TensorFlow", "Apache Spark", "DuckDB"),
  Category = c("Language", "Language", "IDE", "IDE", "IDE",
               "Version Control", "Container", "Database", "Visualization", "Visualization",
               "Publishing", "Platform", "Framework", "Library", "Library",
               "Library", "Library", "Library", "Framework", "Database"),
  Version = c("4.3.2", "3.11", "2023.12", "1.85", "Latest",
              "2.43", "24.0", "16.1", "2023.3", "Latest",
              "1.4", "2023.12", "1.8.0", "5.18", "3.4.4",
              "2.1.4", "1.3.2", "2.15", "3.5.0", "0.10"),
  License = c("GPL", "PSF", "AGPL", "MIT", "BSD",
              "GPL", "Apache", "PostgreSQL", "Proprietary", "Proprietary",
              "GPL", "Proprietary", "GPL", "MIT", "MIT",
              "BSD", "BSD", "Apache", "Apache", "MIT"),
  Support_Level = c("Full", "Full", "Full", "Full", "Full",
                    "Full", "Full", "Full", "Limited", "Limited",
                    "Full", "Full", "Full", "Full", "Full",
                    "Full", "Full", "Community", "Community", "Full"),
  Users = c(156, 189, 145, 167, 98,
            178, 123, 89, 67, 54,
            134, 45, 87, 145, 156,
            178, 98, 67, 34, 56),
  Last_Review = c("2024-01-05", "2024-01-06", "2024-01-04", "2024-01-07", "2024-01-03",
                  "2024-01-08", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-05", "2023-12-20", "2023-12-18",
                  "2024-01-09", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-06", "2024-01-07", "2024-01-05",
                  "2024-01-06", "2024-01-04", "2024-01-03", "2023-12-28", "2024-01-08")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Status = case_when(
      Support_Level == "Full" ~ "Recommended",
      Support_Level == "Limited" ~ "Approved",
      TRUE ~ "Evaluation"
    ),
    Last_Review = as.Date(Last_Review),
    Days_Since_Review = as.numeric(Sys.Date() - Last_Review),
    Adoption_Rate = round(Users / max(Users) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category, desc(Users))

# Create interactive table
datatable(software_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 20,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel')
          ),
          filter = 'top',
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "Approved Software Catalog") %>%
  formatStyle('Status',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('Recommended', 'Approved', 'Evaluation'),
                c('#d4edda', '#d1ecf1', '#fff3cd')
              )) %>%
  formatStyle('Adoption_Rate',
              background = styleColorBar(c(0, 100), '#4b7874'),
              backgroundSize = '95% 75%',
              backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat',
              backgroundPosition = 'center') %>%
  formatDate('Last_Review', 'toDateString')
```
